remarks:
This home with attached garage and workshop is located in Rushford NY, Allegany County.

This 3-bedroom home offers a flexible floor plan, finished basement, attached garage, detached workshop-garage, and a nice-sized yard.  The lot size is 0.37 acres.

The main level has an easy flow between the living and dining rooms connected by a wide arched opening. Hardwood floors run through both rooms, and multiple windows bring in natural light. The kitchen offers generous cabinet and counter space, open shelving, stainless steel appliances, and a large window above the sink. The first-floor bedroom is currently used as the laundry room and has hardwood flooring. Keep the convenience of main-level laundry or return the space to bedroom use.

Upstairs are two bedrooms including the primary with extensive built-in storage that makes excellent use of the roofline. Additional built-ins in the upstairs hallway provide even more practical storage. The finished basement adds flexible space for recreation, hobbies, a play area, or storage and includes an additional bathroom area.

Outside, the property offers spaces designed for both projects and downtime. The attached garage provides parking and storage. The detached garage is set up as a workshop with workbenches and room for tools, equipment, and projects. An adjoining screened-in area provides a covered spot for outdoor meals or enjoying summer evenings. Raised garden beds, a separate fire-pit area, and open lawn offer room for gardening, play, pets, and get-togethers.

Located in the quiet and friendly Town of Rushford, you’ll enjoy the tranquility of small-town living while still having easy access to nearby amenities.  The property is located 15 minutes from Cuba NY, 35 minutes from Olean NY, and an hour and 25 minutes from Buffalo NY.

Inside and out, this home offers practical spaces for everyday living, projects, gardening, and time together.
